p: As a treasure to be kept by them, who were of the number of the Levites.
panteth after the water brooks: By these comparisons of the thirst and panting, he shows his fervent desire to serve God in his temple.
My tears have been my meat: As others take pleasure in eating and drinking, so he was altogether given to weeping.
these things: That is, how I led the people to serve you in your tabernacle, and now seeing my contrary estate, I die for sorrow.
hope thou in God: Though he sustained grievous assaults of the flesh to cast him into despair, yet his faith grounded on God's accustomed mercies gets the victory.
therefore will I remember thee from: That is, when I remember you in this land of my banishment among the mountains.
Deep calleth unto deep at the: Afflictions came so thick upon me that I felt overwhelmed: by which he shows there is no end to our misery till God is pacified and sends help.
will command his lovingkindness in the: He assures himself of God's help in time to come.
bones: That is, I am most grievously tormented.
Why art thou cast down: This repetition declares that David did not overcome at once, to teach us to be constant, for as much as God will certainly deliver his.
